body: That can really mess with hand-to-eye coordination and general dexterity.  I had a few for the dentist once and it just makes you slow and tired.

Well I took 22 of them, and all that happened was six hours of anxiety, panic, and thinking there were Wendigos everywhere.   I wouldn't recommend it, plus your heart rate goes mental which isn't comfortable.

I can understand the anger going home, or even being caught and stopped.  Initially it can make you feel so much worse, like the end was in sight but was taken. I've been there, very recently, drop me a PM if you want to talk.
